verdict.rationale: Abacum documents ERP and accounting-system integrations and says P&L, balance sheet and cash flow are built off live actuals from your ERP, with actuals flowing in automatically and no copy-paste. A community comment also describes integration toggles and data-mapping menus in the UI. missing for 10: explicit naming of QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite as supported connectors, documented sync cadence/automation details, confirmation that founders can set this up self-serve, and independent hands-on corroboration of the actuals sync.
